rule_or_pattern: On two-column pages drop every line whose crop is wider than 0.55 x the text width (cross-gutter boxes), plus all lines flagged C:cpp_vs_book_out, C:cph_out_of_range or C:len_vs_book_high (label is a short fragment under a long crop, or two columns joined).
notes: This is an 1864 polytonic two-column parliament record. Single-column lines (1-3, 5-7, 9-11, 17, 18, 20) read correctly, polytonic marks included. Many lines are cross-gutter crops: 4, 14, 15, 19 and 21-33 join both columns. In 12, 13, 16 and 34-39 the crop spans both columns but the label is a short fragment of one side or of another line ('ὁποίαν ὁ Π. Ν. ὥρισεν.', '. Αλλὰ, Κύριοι, δὲν', 'ΗΡ. ΠΕΤΙΜΕΖΑΣ' under 'ΗΡ. ΠΕΤΙΜΕΖΑΣ. Κύριοι, κατὰ τὴν ἐποχὴν...'). Dropping the wide and fragment-flagged lines leaves usable single-column lines.
